create_DLRM_Net: create a DLRM_Net model with configurable MLP layers, embedding tables, and interaction operators in Caffe2
run_DLRM_Net_training: run the DLRM model training loop with mini-batch SGD optimization and BCE or MSE loss
create_mlp_layers: create multi-layer perceptron layers with Xavier-initialized weights and configurable ReLU or sigmoid activations
create_embedding_tables: create sparse embedding lookup tables using SparseLengthsSum operators distributed across GPU devices
calculate_metrics: calculate validation metrics including loss, recall, precision, f1, average precision, roc_auc, and accuracy
